Name: Ahaziah, King of Judah
Summary: Ahaziah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah, reigned one year, walked in the ways of Ahab's house, and was slain by Jehu while visiting the wounded Jehoram of Israel at Jezreel.
KeyStory: Ahaziah visits Jehoram and is slain by Jehu.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Judah; Athaliah; Jehu, King of Israel; Jehoram, King of Israel; Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram; Jehu, Son of Nimshi
LifeLesson: A one-year reign can still reveal a heart: Ahaziah followed his mother's house rather than the LORD.
